assets.prompt:
Use case: character-redesign. Production transparent character expression atlas for a mature, mysterious tarot room. The reference is ONLY an identity, palette and wardrobe reference. Its oversized doll head and short torso are defects: DO NOT copy its body proportions. Completely redraw Star Moon as a naturally proportioned adult woman of about 28, elegant cinematic painterly realism, calm natural eyes, detailed but not doll-like face. Dark chestnut wavy hair, small crescent hair pin, star earrings, ivory lace collar, deep emerald velvet robe and fitted dark waistcoat with restrained antique-gold moon embroidery.
Output ONE square transparent PNG, exactly THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows, SIX equal crown-to-low-hips figures. Every figure fits within its own 2:3 portrait cell, with transparent margins. Frontal standing posture for a seated-character rig reference, camera at chest level, no perspective distortion. Same anatomy, costume, pose, alignment and lighting across all six figures. Reading order: neutral attentive; tiny closed-mouth smile; focused slightly downward eyes; softly closed eyes; thoughtful eyes slightly to one side; duplicate neutral.
PROPORTIONS ARE THE PRIMARY REQUIREMENT. Draw a normal adult, NOT a big-headed fantasy doll: crown to hips approximately 4.5 anatomical head heights; face/head width about ONE THIRD of shoulder width. Within each cell: hair crown at 5% height, chin at 25%, shoulder joints at 32%, natural waist at 81%, low hips at 95%. Long coherent upper torso, natural neck, broad enough shoulders, a full ribcage, natural waist, and softly substantial upper arms. Hair must not inflate the apparent skull. No giant eyes, baby cheeks, chibi, anime proportions or pin-head.
Include the complete connected shoulders, upper arms, forearms and normal adult hands. Arms hang comfortably down at the sides, slightly separated from the waist, relaxed fingers outside the torso silhouette, so they can be rigged separately. Hands must be proportional, about 65% of face height; no bony hands, no thin dry arms. Visible natural sleeve volume with soft velvet folds. The face, neck, collar, chest, arms and hips must be ONE coherent painting with no pasted pieces. Keep the entire crown, sleeves, fingers and hips inside each cell, no cropping or overlap between cells.
Soft warm candle light from the left, cool moon fill from the right, restrained refined oil-paint realism matching the room. No props, table, scene, text, labels, borders, grid lines, halos, glow, checkerboard or background. Genuine transparent alpha outside the figure, fully opaque face and clothing.

Use case: game-asset. Create the matching production LIMB RIG atlas for the adult Star Moon character in reference image 1. Reference supplies the EXACT new costume, mature anatomy, skin tone and lighting. Do not redraw the head or torso. A square PNG with FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows, twelve isolated transparent limb parts, one part per cell with 12% clear margin. No text, labels, grid, background or props.
Exact reading order is essential:
Row 1: left upper sleeve, right upper sleeve, left forearm sleeve, right forearm sleeve.
Row 2: left relaxed hand BACK with cuff, right relaxed hand BACK with cuff, left hand SIDE with cuff, right hand SIDE with cuff.
Row 3: left open upward PALM with cuff, right open upward PALM with cuff, left soft curled gripping hand with cuff, right soft curled gripping hand with cuff.
UPPER SLEEVES: a single substantial emerald velvet shoulder-to-elbow sleeve section, vertical axis with shoulder at top and elbow at bottom, adult anatomy, softly rounded puff at upper arm, natural tailored folds, gently tapered lower end. Ends have overlapping continuous fabric to hide rig joints. No hand, no forearm, no collar, no torso and NO wrist cuff on upper sleeve.
FOREARM SLEEVES: a single emerald velvet elbow-to-wrist sleeve section, vertical axis elbow top wrist bottom, comfortable fuller cloth volume and believable folds, taper gently toward wrist. Fabric ends only, NO ivory cuff or hand attached. Match gold embroidery sparsely.
ALL HANDS: natural adult female hands with five anatomically correct fingers, healthy soft volume, comfortable knuckles, proportional palms, neither bony/dry nor inflated. Same ivory lace cuff and narrow embroidered velvet wrist band integrated at the TOP of every hand cell; fingers point DOWN in all cells. Wrist center at the SAME normalized point, cuff and hand same apparent size across back, side, palm and curled poses. Back, side and palm are a gentle rotation of the SAME hand and cuff, no separate sleeve popping. Side profile is narrower but connected. Left/right are true anatomical complements.
Fine mature oil-painted cinematic realism, candlelight warm left and cool moon fill right, deep emerald velvet matching the figure. Opaque texture, genuine transparent alpha outside parts. No floating extra fingers, duplicate hands, giant cuffs, detached skin, halo, glow, checkerboard or background.
